title: Q-YEAR-cloudflare-alerts: route Cloudflare alerts into the tick Worker
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** UNATTENDED-365 register, dependency `cloudflare-alerts` is open
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation unattended --probe cloudflare-alerts
**Status:** closed

Add a signed webhook route on the tick Worker, register it as an alerting destination, and create policies for incident_alert, workers_observability_alert, billing_usage_alert and universal_ssl_event_type that post to it; each alert becomes a queue item with a closing probe.
When it holds, set the dependency's status to closed in doctrine/unattended.json with the evidence and a probe that resolves.

**Disposition:** fixed (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 23.7 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).

**Evidence:** 2026-11-22T06:51:11Z closing probe passed after the item was disposed: cloudflare-alerts: closed
